ambient.title: Session Voice to Compliant Note — Before the Patient Leaves
ambient.sub: Murphi.ai listens during the clinical session and generates structured notes in the format your EHR and payers require. Assessment scores auto-populate from the same audio. Clinicians review and approve — one tap to write to EHR.

note.text: Client presented with mild anxiety related to occupational stressors. Engaged appropriately throughout session, maintained eye contact.
CBT techniques applied — cognitive restructuring and thought record exercise completed. Grounding strategies reviewed.
Client demonstrated improved insight into cognitive distortions. Subjective distress reduced from 7/10 to 4/10.
Continue CBT protocol. Client to complete thought diary before next session. Follow-up in 1 week.
